videos.title: GTA 6 Made $3.79 Billion in ONE Day 🌴 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
On Nov 20, Rockstar and Take-Two said GTA 6 earned $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales (company estimate through launch day) — nearly 5x GTA 5's ~$800M first day in 2013. Sensor Tower's independent estimate is lower (~$2.36B), and no official copy count has been shared.

Sources: Variety, Forbes, ABC News (AP), PC Gamer

videos.title: Rockstar Staff Are Voting on a Union During GTA 6 Launch 🌴 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Rockstar's UK staff are voting online and anonymously from Nov 12 to Nov 26 on recognizing the IWGB union — the union says it would cover 1,600+ workers. It's a recognition vote, not a strike, and follows Rockstar's 2025 firings, which the studio says were over leaks; the result is expected after Nov 26.

Sources: PC Gamer, Game Developer, Dexerto, Insider Gaming
